map.输入载荷、轴径、宽径比、转速及要求寿命，计算 pV 值并推荐轴承类型与所需额定动: Enter load, shaft diameter, width-to-diameter ratio, speed and required life to compute the pV value and recommend bearing type and required dynamic load rating
map.轴承额定动载 C = f(寿命, 转速): Bearing dynamic load rating C = f(life, speed)
map.平均压强 p=F/(d·B)、pV=p·v 校核。: Mean pressure p = F/(d·B), and check pV = p·v.
map.由目标寿命反算所需额定载荷。: Back out the required dynamic load rating from a target life.
map.宽径比 B/d 取值合理性。: Reasonableness of the width-to-diameter ratio B/d.
map.：F=8 kN、d=50 mm、B/d=0.8→B=40 mm、v=2 m/s：: : F = 8 kN, d = 50 mm, B/d = 0.8 -> B = 40 mm, v = 2 m/s: p = 8000/(50 × 40) = 4 MPa; pV = 4 × 2 = 8 MPa·m/s. Below the allowable value for babbitt (about 10-15), so it passes.
map.：B/d 常取 0.5–1.5；过小压强高、过大端泄大。上例 0.8 合理。: : B/d is commonly 0.5-1.5; too small raises pressure and too large leaks at the ends. The 0.8 above is reasonable.
map.车削/铣削切削速度与进给量: Turning and milling cutting speed and feed
map.滑动轴承为何看 pV？: Why look at pV for plain bearings?
map.pV 正比于摩擦发热功率密度，超限则油膜破裂、抱轴，是滑动轴承核心限制。: pV is proportional to frictional heating power density; exceeding the limit ruptures the oil film and seizes the shaft, making it the core constraint for plain bearings.
map.与滚动轴承寿命区别？: How does it differ from rolling bearing life?
map.滚动轴承用 L10 疲劳寿命（转数）；滑动轴承按 pV 与磨损/温升，不称\"转: Rolling bearings use L10 fatigue life (revolutions); plain bearings are judged by pV and wear/temperature rise, not called a 'revolution life'.
